assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square app icon artwork for the Expo iOS application InfiniChat, a personal AI chat application.
Primary request: Design one beautiful original app icon where a bold continuous infinity loop subtly also reads as a conversation symbol. Use two generously open rounded loops connected into one flowing silhouette, with a single small integrated speech-bubble tail. The infinity and conversation ideas should feel like one simple designed mark.
Scene/backdrop: solid forest green #426A4B filling the entire square edge to edge.
Style/medium: refined minimal graphic icon, crisp smooth curves, flat warm-white #F8F8F4 symbol, balanced negative space, precise optical balance.
Composition/framing: one large centered mark occupying about 68 percent of the square width, comfortable clear margins, readable at small home-screen sizes. Request 1024 by 1024 square image.
Constraints: opaque full-bleed square background, no pre-rounded outer corners, no outer device or icon mockup, no border, no text or letters, no watermark, no grid, no extra symbols, no decoration, no gradients. Produce only the single finished icon.

Style/medium: minimal crisp graphic design, forest green #426A4B dominant mark with a restrained sage #B6D6A9 second interlocking segment. Thick smooth contours, two open generous counters, beautiful geometric balance.
Composition/framing: single centered compact mark occupying about 68 percent of square width; generous margins; retain clarity at small app icon sizes. Request 1024 by 1024 square image.
Constraints: opaque full-bleed square, no pre-rounded outer corners, no border or surrounding mockup, no text or lettering, no watermark, no small details or decorative objects, no dots, no gradients. Produce only one finished icon.
